title: BeeHUD
description: Look at any beehive or bee nest to see its honey level, sheltering bee count, and harvest-ready status on a small HUD.
body:
**BeeHUD** is a clean info layer for beekeepers. Point your crosshair at any **beehive** or **bee nest** and a small readout appears in the **top-left** of your screen.

### What it shows
- **Honey level** - the exact `0-5` fill, with a **harvest ready** note the moment it hits 5 (when you can shear it for honeycomb or bottle it for honey).
- **Bees inside** - how many bees are currently sheltering in the hive, out of its capacity of 3.
- **Type** - whether you're looking at a crafted *Beehive* or a naturally generated *Bee Nest*.

### Why
Vanilla gives you no clean way to read a hive. The honey level is only a subtle texture change, and the number of bees inside is invisible unless you break the hive - which angers the colony. BeeHUD puts honey fill and occupancy on screen so you can time your harvest perfectly (wait for level 5, harvest with a campfire under it to keep the bees calm) and check a hive is fully populated before you move it.

### Controls
- **B** - toggle the readout on/off. An action-bar message confirms the state.

### Compatibility
**Minecraft 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11** - Fabric Loader 0.16+. One JAR covers all four. Pure client-side: install on your client only, works on any Fabric server, fully vanilla-compatible. Requires Fabric API.
